About This Campaign

For over forty years, the Keep has been training adventurers. Somehow, the Caves of Chaos are still full, and nobody can quite explain why. In this Greyhawk campaign for D&D 2024 (5.5), you start at level 1 in or around a fortress of opportunity, mild concern, and aggressively archived intentions, where the bureaucracy is as dangerous as the wilderness.

The game blends narrative roleplay with tactical, grid-based combat. Your characters' choices matter, your fights are positioned and planned, and the satire is played with a straight face and a sly grin. The world reacts like it's watching, because it is, and it learns how you fight. Expect moments of glory earned through panic, and lore that rewards curiosity and punishes hubris.

It's a Tier 1 campaign of 4 to 10 sessions, run like a good heist: tight, character-focused, and always a little off the rails. The story comes first and your dice are yours. The rest is paperwork.
